{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shore Guard''' was a part of the [[Alanciari military|military forces]] of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], that was ruled by a military government prior to [[2975 BBY]]. They served as the coast guard and were tasked with patrolling the shores of the western sea.
